data.name: Qawamun
data.gender_notes: Qawamun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is steadfast and strong, capable of withstanding challenges and adversity. The name Qawamun carries the meaning “Powerful, Strong” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qawamun usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the concept of Qawwamun in the Quran, signifying the divine support and protection that sustains one's faith and life
data.etymology: Qawamun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Strong.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qawamun total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_urdu.name: قوامون

in_english.name: Qawamun
in_english.meaning: Those who stand firm in their faith and carry out Allah's commands
in_english.long_meaning: Qawamun refers to those who stand firm in their faith and carry out Allah's commands. They are those who have strong faith and are steadfast in their devotion to Allah, who obey Allah's commands, who are devoted to their duties, who are righteous in their actions, who have good character, who are patient and persevering, who are humble and modest, who are kind and compassionate, who are just and fair, who are honest and trustworthy, who are pious and God-fearing, who are merciful and benevolent. They are the ones who strive to live a righteous life, who seek knowledge and wisdom, who are mindful of their duties and responsibilities, who are grateful for Allah's blessings, and who hope for Allah's reward.
